set -eu
case "$(uname -m)" in x86_64) arch=amd64 ;; aarch64) arch=arm64 ;; *) echo "no build for $(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
version=$(curl -fsSL https://checkpoint-api.hashicorp.com/v1/check/terraform | sed -n 's/.*"current_version":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')

python3 -c 'import sys, zipfile; zipfile.ZipFile(sys.argv[1]).extract("terraform", sys.argv[2])' "$dir/$zip" "$dir"
mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"
install -m 0755 "$dir/terraform" "$HOME/.local/bin/terraform"

App.Name: station-menubar
App.Description: Station's menu bar app, from the latest release

Install.Line:
set -eu
repo=jterrazz/studio-station
tag=$(curl -fsSL "https://api.github.com/repos/$repo/releases/latest" | sed -n 's/.*"tag_name": *"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')
if [ -z "$tag" ]; then
    echo "the latest release did not answer · try again" >&2
    exit 1
fi
base="https://github.com/$repo/releases/download/$tag"
work=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
curl -fsSL "$base/Station.app.zip" -o "$work/Station.app.zip"
curl -fsSL "$base/checksums.txt" -o "$work/checksums.txt"
expected=$(awk '$2 == "Station.app.zip" { print $1 }' "$work/checksums.txt")
actual=$(shasum -a 256 "$work/Station.app.zip" | awk '{ print $1 }')
if [ -z "$expected" ] || [ "$expected" != "$actual" ]; then
    echo "Station.app.zip does not match its checksum · nothing installed" >&2
    exit 1
fi
ditto -x -k "$work/Station.app.zip" "$work"
codesign --verify --strict "$work/Station.app"
app="$HOME/Applications/Station.app"
mkdir -p "$HOME/Applications"
rm -rf "$app.new" "$app.old"
ditto "$work/Station.app" "$app.new"
if [ -d "$app" ]; then mv "$app" "$app.old"; fi
if ! mv "$app.new" "$app"; then
    if [ -d "$app.old" ]; then mv "$app.old" "$app"; fi
    exit 1
fi
rm -rf "$app.old"

Paths.Note: its window, recent pages and sparkline choices

Removal.~/Applications/Station.app: `make menubar-uninstall`'s two steps remove it: `~/Applications/Station.app/Contents/MacOS/StationMenuBar --unregister-login-item`, then deleting the bundle

Disk.NoErase: nothing to erase: its pages are station's, its choices are kept
